notes: The hierarchy and conditional Backtester delegation support feedback-driven operation, but detailed execution traces and controller rules are absent. Temporal validity is limited to incrementally revealed historical data in case studies; cross-validation chronology and separation from ten-year DRL backtests are unspecified. Profit examples are theoretical, with no transaction-cost or risk-adjusted evaluation. RAG, generic dynamic-context/memory descriptions, and dynamic scaling are not established as separately contributed mechanisms. No LLM parameter training is reported. Reconciliation also adds the dedicated timeframe/interval data-preparation interface (L196-L202) and backtest-informed forecast-to-investment synthesis (L215-L230), which the current card omitted. The wave-analysis id is retained for the extraction child of the split.

changes: Retain the existing id for the separable Elliott-wave extraction tool; assign GTS, processing, and mapped.
Move DRL prediction validation, retained test experience, and trading-strategy learning into a separate TSK module with task_procedure.

Remove retired Control, Verification, and Feedback; classify within-episode backtesting checks as Planning and Orchestration and strategy learning across historical experience as Optimization and Evolution.
Add Memory and Context for the explicitly retained past tests.
reconciliation.reason: L204-L207 introduce a tool that enumerates all wave candidates and plots them without a prediction objective. L208-L214 separately assign DRL validation and stored tests to the Backtester; L262-L266 describe trading-strategy learning. Extraction can serve analysis, forecasting, or decision support unchanged, whereas backtesting embeds predictive and trading criteria. R1 therefore requires splitting the reusable mechanisms and R3 assigns their distinct scopes.

changes: Keep GH and the existing id.
Map Planning and Workflow and Coordination and Scaling to Planning and Orchestration.
Populate source-supported forecasting_prediction, decision_support, and temporal_analysis memberships.
Keep demonstrated reuse at work level; add explicit R3 tests and packet evidence.
reconciliation.reason: L303-L310 explicitly describe the system's hierarchical asynchronous delegation and bidirectional reporting. The coordination mechanism has neither temporal data semantics nor a task-specific objective, so R3_3 retains GH. The packet supports hierarchy, but its generic discussion does not establish implemented dynamic scaling.

items.item: wave-analysis layer move TSK->GTS (split from backtesting)
items.result: wave-analysis is GTS (processing); drl-backtesting is a separate TSK module
items.reason: The tool only finds all possible impulsive and corrective wave patterns and overlays them on charts; it carries no forecast, action or reward criterion (R3_1 no), while depending on ordered price-series structure (R3_2 yes). Backtesting/validation of predictions and buy/sell learning is bound to the prediction/trading objective, so it stays TSK.
Output is an investment plan with price levels, dates and buy/sell signals, embedding a decision-support output requirement.

adjudication.summary: Accepted the merged record: the old combined wave-analysis TSK module is split into a GTS wave-extraction tool and a TSK backtesting module per R3. No other errors found.
